🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. A massive landslide occurred in Lete, Mustang, after part of the hillside suddenly collapsed. However, the area remains at risk following the landslide, and locals and travelers have been urged to stay alert, exercise caution and follow safety precautions. The Narapass–Hilsa section of Nepal’s Karnali Corridor has resumed operations after being blocked by heavy snowfall. The road, located at an altitude of approximately 4,500 metres, was cleared using heavy machinery and made suitable for traffic. The reopening brings relief to Nepali citizens working in Taklakot, China, making it easier for them to return home during the festive season. Foreign Tourists Join Nepal’s Dashain Celebrations, Experience Tika and Jamara Foreign tourists visiting Nepal celebrated Dashain by receiving Tika and Jamara, gaining a firsthand experience of the country’s rich cultural traditions. Hotels in Thamel and Sauraha organized celebrations that allowed visitors to take part in the festive atmosphere and learn more about Nepali customs. In Sauraha, more than 35 tourists from countries including the USA, France, Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands participated in the celebrations. Many expressed excitement at experiencing Dashain away from their home countries, highlighting how cultural experiences can strengthen Nepal’s international image for hospitality and diversity.
